    396bce4..1eb11fe  automation/schedule-36877357247-1 -> automation/schedule-36877357247-1
 Took 2.1s
 Perfect! The fix is pushed. The issue was that ReminderScheduler.arm() calls state.plannedReminders(), but this method only existed on the ViewModel, not on the UiState class used in tests.
 The fix adds a test extension function that:
 1. Resolves plans from the bundle using the mustAttend and removedFromPlan sets
 2. Computes reminders using Reminders.forPlans(), which respects plan feasibility
 3. Returns an empty list for days with blocking conflicts (as expected by the test)
 This allows the aConflictedDayArmsNothingUntilResolved test to work correctly: when two activities conflict, the plan is not feasible, so no reminders are scheduled.
